narration_fil: Magkahawig ang dalawang halamang tinatawag na “tsaang gubat” sa isang bakuran. Nagtanong ang residente kung alin ang gagamitin.
narration_en: Two yard plants share the local name “tsaang gubat.” A resident asks which one to use.

narration_en: Find the botanical name and listed part in a current PITAHC card. If identity is uncertain, do not prepare or provide it. Ask about symptoms and medicines; consult a clinician.
